let(
  ranked = sort(fees),
  {
    pool: unique(concat(primary, backup)),
    cheapest: first(ranked),
    dearest: last(ranked),
    top_two: take(reverse(ranked), 2),
    middle: slice(ranked, 1, 2),
    all_fees: flatten(groups),
    spread: abs(first(ranked) - last(ranked)),
    ceiling: ceil(float(last(ranked)) / 7.0),
    base: floor(float(first(ranked)) / 7.0),
    average: round(float(sum(fees)) / float(len(fees)))
  }
)

examples.description: 主路是一次宽 fallback 级联，备份池用推导式逐个报价、失败的自动落到挂牌价，reduce 取最低后再与主路比价

let(
  primary = fallback(
    route.fee_quote_v1(status_01, 0.018),
    route.fee_quote_v1(status_02, 0.020),
    route.fee_quote_v1(status_03, 0.022),
    route.fee_quote_v1(status_04, 0.024),
    route.fee_quote_v1(status_05, 0.026),
    listed_fee
  ),
  pool = [fallback(route.fee_quote_v1(pool_status, fee), listed_fee) for fee in pool_fees],
  cheapest = min(pool),
  {
    "primary": primary,
    "pool_best": cheapest,
    "chosen": switch(case cheapest < primary => cheapest, else => primary)
  }
)

examples.label: 全球支付决策
examples.description: 合规、风险、渠道、币种、额度各由最合适的结构算成一个局部量，最后一条扁平条件链收口，而不是十层 switch 套娃
examples.source:
let(
  flagged = len([name for name, hit in watchlists if hit]),
  risk = fallback(model.fraud_v1(model.embed_v1(features)), risk_fallback),
  candidates = [name for name, status in channel_statuses if route.is_healthy_v1(status)],
  live = len(candidates),
  settlement = switch(case currency == settlement_currency => "local", else => "fx"),
  tier = switch(
    case amount >= high_value_limit => "high",
    case amount <= minimum_amount   => "micro",
    else => "standard"
  ),
  needs_3ds = method == "card" && !three_ds_completed && amount > three_ds_limit,
  switch(
    case !enabled            => "disabled",
    case flagged > 0         => "reject:compliance",
    case risk >= risk_reject => "reject:risk",
    case risk >= risk_review => "review:risk",
    case tier == "micro"     => "reject:minimum",
    case tier == "high"      => "review:high_value",
    case live == 0           => "hold:no_channel",
    case needs_3ds           => "challenge:3ds",
    else => "route:" + settlement + ":" + capture_mode
  )
)

examples.label: 结构化支付编排
examples.description: 模型评分与信号计数先定处置，每个下游阶段只管自己那一件事，最后由一个 if 决定发出放行包还是拦截包
examples.source:
let(
  risk = fallback(model.fraud_v1(model.embed_v1(features)), risk_fallback),
  hits = len([name for name, fired in signals if fired]),
  action = switch(
    case blocked => "reject",
    case risk >= 0.90 => "review",
    case hits >= 2 => "review",
    case amount > review_limit => "review",
    else => "approve"
  ),
  route = switch(
    case country == "BR" && method == "bank" => "pix",
    case method == "wallet" => "wallet",
    case route.is_healthy_v1(primary_health) => "adyen",
    else => "stripe"
  ),
  auth_mode = switch(
    case method != "card" => "native",
    case amount > three_ds_limit => "three_ds",
    else => "frictionless"
  ),
  capture = switch(case risk >= 0.70 => "manual", else => "auto"),
  if(action == "approve",
    {"action": action, "route": route, "auth": auth_mode, "capture": capture, "reason": "approved"},
    {"action": action, "route": "none", "auth": "none", "capture": "none",
     "reason": switch(action, case "reject" => "risk_or_blocklist", else => "manual_review")}
  )
)

examples.label: 跨境结算流水线
examples.description: reduce 汇总明细，顺序 let 表达十段计算流水线，条件费用由 switch 决定，最后打包成数组字典
examples.source:
let(
  gross = sum(line_items),
  interchange = gross * interchange_bps / 10000,
  scheme_fee = gross * scheme_bps / 10000,
  fx_fee = switch(case cross_border => gross * fx_bps / 10000, else => 0),
  gateway_fee = gross * gateway_bps / 10000 + fixed_fee,
  total_fee = interchange + scheme_fee + fx_fee + gateway_fee,
  reserve = gross * reserve_bps / 10000,
  net_before_tax = gross - total_fee - reserve,
  withholding = switch(case taxable => net_before_tax * tax_bps / 10000, else => 0),
  payable = net_before_tax - withholding,
  {"fees": [interchange, scheme_fee, fx_fee, gateway_fee, total_fee], "settlement": [gross, reserve, withholding, payable]}
)

examples.label: 默认值与覆盖层
examples.description: 字典缺键是错误而不是空值，所以兜底写 get(d, k, default)；两层配置叠加写 merge(默认, 覆盖)，键相同时取后者

types.Effective: record{sg: int, us: int, unknown: int, configured: int}

args.name: defaults
args.doc: 各地区默认费率，单位：基点

args.name: overrides
args.doc: 本次生效的覆盖，键相同时优先

result.doc: 生效费率与已配置的地区数

examples.label: 按币种计费并封顶
examples.description: 金额的币种是值的属性：money(30, currency(amount)) 在交易的币种里造出 30 个最小单位的固定费，2.9% 是精确的比例；与封顶额相比较时两边币种不同是运行时的 ErrCurrency

args.name: cap
args.doc: 手续费封顶，与交易同币种

examples.label: 拆开的金额与币种
examples.description: 输入里金额与币种常常分开：money 用最小单位整数和币种造出金额，currency_of 校验币种代码；minor、currency、sign 再把它拆开

types.Parts: record{amount: money, currency: currency, cents: int, sign: int}

args.name: order
args.doc: 上游传来的订单：最小单位金额与币种代码

examples.label: 分摊不丢分
examples.description: 按权重分一笔钱，各份加起来一定等于原额：各份向零取整，剩下的最小单位按最大余数法发出，被舍掉最多的份先得
examples.source: allocate(total, [2, 1, 1])

examples.label: 分摊策略
examples.description: 余数怎么发由末尾的策略说：@all_last 把舍入差全部交给最后一份，比如收单行那一份；另有 @largest_remainder（缺省）、@largest_weight、@in_order、@reverse_order、@all_first
examples.source: allocate(total, [1, 1, 1], @all_last)

examples.label: 文本费率加通道费
examples.description: 费率从配置里读出来是文本：ratio 把十进制文本精确读成比例，再加上 25bps 的通道费与 USD 0.30 的固定费；浮点数不能当费率
examples.source: round(amount * (ratio(fee_text) + 25bps), @half_even) + USD 0.30

examples.label: 跨境结算换汇
examples.description: -> 按 using 列出的报价换汇，这里是作为参数传入的市场价报价 market；结果币种由目标币种决定，round 选定这一步的舍入方式，这里向下取整不多付
examples.source: using(market, round(amount -> JPY, @down))

examples.label: 多币种历史折成美元
examples.description: 每笔订单币种不同：各自换成美元才能加在一起；报价里没有某个币种的汇率是 ErrNoFxRate
examples.source: using(market, sum([round(money(o.amount, o.currency) -> USD, @half_even) for o in history]))

args.name: history
args.doc: 过去的订单，最小单位金额与币种

examples.label: 费率加固定费，保底封顶
examples.description: 最常见的商户扣率：百分比加每笔固定费，再落在保底与封顶之间；min、max 对同币种金额直接可用
examples.source: min(max(round(amount * 2.9%, @half_even) + money(30, currency(amount)), floor_fee), cap)

examples.label: 阶梯费率
examples.description: 按商户本月交易量分档定费率：量越大费率越低，金额阈值直接写成带币种的字面量

examples.label: Interchange++ 透传
examples.description: 交换费、卡组织费按实际透传，再加收单机构的加价；三段比例先相加，整体只舍入一次
examples.source: round(amount * (interchange + scheme_fee + markup), @half_even) + USD 0.05

examples.label: 按卡组织取费率
examples.description: 各卡组织的费率放在字典里，没配的卡组织按 3% 兜底
examples.source: round(amount * get(rates, brand, 3%), @half_even)

examples.label: 反推含费金额
examples.description: 商户想到账 100 美元，该向顾客收多少：净额加固定费再除以 100% 减费率，向上取整保证不少收

examples.label: 退款退还手续费
examples.description: 部分退款时按退款占比退还手续费：prorate(fee, refund, amount) 是 fee × refund / amount，中间精确、只舍入一次
examples.source: {refund: refund, fee_back: round(prorate(fee, refund, amount), @half_even)}

examples.label: 现金舍入
examples.description: 瑞士法郎现金以 0.05 为最小面额：round_to 把金额取到粒度的整数倍，粒度是同币种的金额；它本身就是一次舍入，所以舍入方式写在最后
examples.source: round_to(amount, CHF 0.05, @half_up)

examples.label: 最低成本路由
examples.description: 每个渠道的报价是费率加固定费；算出这笔金额在各渠道的成本，选最便宜的

types.Quote: record{name: string, rate: ratio, fixed: money}

examples.label: 成本与成功率权衡
examples.description: 便宜的渠道不一定划算：用成本除以成功率，得到每笔成功交易的期望成本，再选最小的

types.Offer: record{name: string, rate: ratio, fixed: money, approval: ratio}

examples.label: 按币种阈值走 3DS
examples.description: 强认证阈值按币种配置在字典里（最小单位）；money(n, currency(amount)) 在交易的币种里造出阈值金额再比较
examples.source: if(amount > money(get(thresholds, string(currency(amount)), 50000), currency(amount)), "challenge", "frictionless")

args.name: thresholds
args.doc: 各币种的 3DS 阈值，最小单位

examples.label: 渠道报价比价（宿主函数）
examples.description: 报价来自宿主的 Go 函数：它用 lang.Money 的方法计算，与规则里的舍入完全一致；两份报价同币种，直接比较

examples.label: 平台分账
examples.description: 平台抽佣 8%，支付通道收 2.9% 加固定费，剩下的给卖家；三方都是同一币种的金额

types.Split: record{seller: money, platform: money, processor: money}

examples.label: 分期付款
examples.description: 加上分期手续费后平均分成 6 期，一分不丢：除不尽的分摊在前几期
examples.source: allocate(price + round(price * fee_rate, @half_even), 6)

examples.label: 净额结算换成美元
examples.description: 当日交易总额扣掉按比例和按笔的手续费（按笔的 30 个最小单位与总额同币种），再按市场价报价换成美元

examples.label: 动态货币转换加点
examples.description: DCC：在市场价上加 3.5% 的点差再换成顾客本币。fx(EUR, USD) 读出外层 market 里的汇率，汇率乘比例是同一货币对的加点汇率，内层 using 用它换汇只舍入一次
examples.source: using(market, using(fx(EUR, USD) * (100% + 3.5%), round(amount -> USD, @half_even)))

examples.label: 经美元交叉换汇
examples.description: 市场价报价里只有美元报价：日元换欧元就在规则里写明经美元的两跳。第一跳取 USD/JPY 的倒数，第二跳用 USD/EUR；语言从不自己找中转货币，所以用哪条汇率一眼就能看出来
examples.source: using(market, round(amount -> USD -> EUR, @half_even))

examples.label: 成交汇率偏离报警
examples.description: 按市场价算出应到账的欧元，与实际到账相除得偏离比例，超过 ±0.5% 就报警

examples.label: 汇率缺失兜底
examples.description: 报价里没有这一对货币是 ErrNoFxRate，fallback 接住它。兜底值要让下游认得出来：兜底成 0 的金额在成本比较里会被当成最便宜的通道，所以这里连同一个 priced 标记一起返回
examples.source: using(market, fallback({jpy: round(amount -> JPY, @half_even), priced: true}, {jpy: JPY 0, priced: false}))

result.doc: 到账日元，以及是否真的按汇率换了

examples.label: 按成交价换汇
examples.description: using 只用写在里面的汇率：这笔按实际成交价 implied(到账额, 支付额) 换
examples.source: using(implied(settled, paid), round(amount -> EUR, @half_even))

examples.label: 沿用外层的报价
examples.description: 内层 using 只用写在里面的汇率，要沿用外层 market 里的报价就用 fx(USD, JPY) 读出来写进去：报价里只有 USD/JPY，再写上 1.08 USD / EUR，欧元就能先换美元、再换日元。换汇是单跳的，经过哪种货币由规则写明
examples.source: using(market, using(1.08 USD / EUR, fx(USD, JPY), round(amount -> USD -> JPY, @half_even)))

examples.label: 链式换汇
examples.description: 每个 -> 只用报价里这一对货币的报价（或反方向报价的倒数），从不自己找中转货币；要经过人民币就写两跳。和 round 里的其他运算一样，中间的 CNY 保持精确，round 在最后只舍入一次
examples.source: using(market, round(amount -> CNY -> USD, @half_even))

examples.label: 只用协议价
examples.description: using 只用这里写的报价，不读任何其他汇率。150.25 JPY / USD 是报价的写法：数字在前、分母是单写的币种，小数位不受币种限制
examples.source: using(150.25 JPY / USD, round(amount -> JPY, @half_even))

examples.label: 市场价优先、协议价兜底
examples.description: fallback 加 using 是整段备选：先按市场价报价 market 换，找不到汇率（ErrNoFxRate）再整段改用协议价。两边的汇率不会拼成一条路径
examples.source: fallback(using(market, round(amount -> JPY, @half_even)), using(150 JPY / USD, round(amount -> JPY, @half_even)))

examples.label: 两组报价
examples.description: 汇率就是参数：契约声明两组报价（市场价 market 与清算价 settlement，都是 array<fxrate>），换汇写在 using(报价, …) 里，每个 using 只用它列出的报价
examples.source: {quoted: using(market, round(amount -> JPY, @half_even)), settled: using(settlement, round(amount -> JPY, @half_even))}

result.doc: 按市场价与按清算价换得的日元

examples.label: 单日累计限额
examples.description: 今天已成交的金额加上这一笔，超过单日限额就拦截；数组里的金额与限额必须同币种
examples.source: sum(today) + amount > limit

args.name: today
args.doc: 今天已成交的各笔金额

examples.label: 稳定币通道：比例加固定费封顶
examples.description: USDT 按业务精度 6 位小数声明；千分之一加每笔 1 USDT，封顶 20 USDT。链上精确金额在宿主记账系统换算，规则只按业务精度计费
examples.source: let(fee = round(amount * 0.1%, @half_even) + USDT 1, if(fee > USDT 20, USDT 20, fee))
